description: Master executed the plaud-ingest workflow directly instead of delegating to Knox via an Agent spawn. The workflow definition explicitly states agent: knox and is designed to run as a background Agent. Master ran the steps itself in the Linux sandbox, which lacks access to ~/.config/plaud/ on the Mac, causing a false 'token missing' failure. Knox (when properly delegated) handled credentials, Chrome login flow awareness, and Mac filesystem access correctly via osascript.
correction: plaud-ingest is always delegated to Knox as a background Agent. Master's role is to spawn the agent and surface Knox's output. Master never executes plaud workflow steps directly.
systemic_fix: When a workflow file specifies 'agent: knox' (or any non-master agent), Master must delegate via Agent spawn — not execute the steps itself. Add this as an explicit routing rule: workflow frontmatter agent field != master → spawn that agent.
